0.why: BufferSludgerTransposer.cpp:56-64 treats 5V and above as reverse when the jack is patched, and falls back to the Reverse mode switch when it is not

1.why: BufferSludgerTransposer.cpp:68 and 75 raise two to the power of this voltage to set the playback speed

comment: The panel letters the first jack REVERSE CTRL and the manual calls it Reverse Control, but BufferSludgerTransposer.cpp:11 configures its tooltip as Reset; the code at lines 56-64 uses it for reverse. The expander is looked for on the left first and then on the right (lines 32-40), so it works on either side.
